open KdVPlan in let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k;
 (∀ f g, Reg f → Reg g → Reg (fun t=>B t (f t) (g t))) ∧
 (∀ a f, Smooth f → Reg (F a f) ∧ Reg (Cst a f) ∧ Reg (Qst a f)) ∧
 (∀ τ : ℝ, 0<τ → ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ f : Coeff, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
   Reg (Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ f))
proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  dsimp only
  let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k
  have basic:=@yui_aux_0064 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have ops:=@yui_aux_0069 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hs :=@yui_aux_0067 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hi :=@yui_aux_0070 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hminus : ∀ f, Reg f → Reg (fun t=>S (-t) (f t)):=by
    intro f hf
    have hh:=ops.2.1 _ (hs _ (ops.2.1 f hf))
    simpa only [neg_neg] using hh
  have hB : ∀ f g, Reg f → Reg g → Reg (fun t=>B t (f t) (g t)):=by
    intro f g hf hg
    have hp:=ops.1 _ _ (hs f hf) (hs g hg)
    have hd:=basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>Complex.I) contDiff_const _ (basic.2.2.2.1 _ hp)
    apply hminus
    simpa only [Reg,dx,scale,mul_assoc] using hd
  have hstage : ∀ a f, Smooth f → Reg (F a f) ∧ Reg (Cst a f) ∧ Reg (Qst a f):=by
    intro a f hf
    have hc:=basic.1 f hf
    have hF :=basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>(1/2:ℂ)) contDiff_const _ (hi _ (hB _ _ hc hc) a)
    refine ⟨hF,hi _ (hB _ _ hc hF) a,?_⟩
    exact basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>(1/2:ℂ)) contDiff_const _ (hi _ (hB _ _ hF hF) a)
  refine ⟨hB,hstage,?_⟩
  intro τ hτ n f hf hfs
  let a : ℝ:=(n:ℝ)*τ
  let b : ℝ:=((n:ℝ)+1)*τ
  have hc:=basic.1 f hfs
  obtain ⟨hF,hC,hQ⟩:=hstage a f hfs
  have hrem : rem a τ f f f=f+F a f b+Cst a f b-S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f)):=by
    have hh:=h_E006 τ hτ n f hf hfs
    change S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f))=f+F a f b+Cst a f b-rem a τ f f f at hh
    calc
      rem a τ f f f = (f+F a f b+Cst a f b)-(f+F a f b+Cst a f b-rem a τ f f f):=by abel
      _ = _ :=by rw [← hh]
  have hu : Smooth (S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f))):=by
    apply (@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1
    exact ((@yui_aux_0044 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 τ _ ((@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 a f hfs)).2.2
  have hW : Smooth (Wst a τ f):=by
    have hsmooth := (@yui_aux_0043 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.2
    have hb : a+τ=b:=by dsimp [a,b]; ring
    unfold Wst
    rw [hrem]
    exact (hsmooth _ _ (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hQ (a+τ))
      ((hsmooth _ _ ((hsmooth _ _ hfs (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hF b)).1) (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hC b)).1 |>
        fun hh=>(hsmooth _ _ hh hu).2)).1
  have hscalar : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t : ℝ=>(((t-a)/τ:ℝ):ℂ)):=by
    apply Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp
    change ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t : ℝ=>(t-a)*τ⁻¹)
    exact (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).mul contDiff_const
  have hcorr:=basic.2.2.1 _ hscalar _ (basic.1 _ hW)
  exact (basic.2.1 _ _ ((basic.2.1 _ _ ((basic.2.1 _ _ hc hF).1) hC).1) hQ).1 |>
    fun hv=>(basic.2.1 _ _ hv hcorr).2)
